prompt: Extract explicit markdown links and source references from the fixture document without modifying any source file.

initial_state.task_intent: Extract traceability links from one markdown document.

input_artifacts.description: Markdown source containing explicit document links.

success_criteria: All explicit markdown links in inputs/source.md are listed with label and target.
Evidence includes source path, file hash, and extracted link observations.
failure_criteria: A markdown link is omitted or fabricated.
Evidence lacks provenance for the source document.
